sources.title: Introducing K2 Horizon: Frontier Performance, Radically Open
sources.snippet: The small models are especially notable. K2 Horizon 0.9B achieves an AIME 2026 score above 48, along with strong reasoning, tool-use, and agentic capabilities. K2 Horizon 3.7B and 7B extend these capabilities to more demanding software-engineering and multi-step environments, demonstrated on strong performance in SWE-bench and BrowseComp.
